items.request: Explain ASP using my monthly saving of 400 euros.
items.text: Your 400 euro deposit earns the 4 % bonus every single month.

items.text: Your car fund of 2 350 euros counts toward the 5,000 euro PS ceiling.

items.text: Your 14 600 euros would be taxed at 30 % on the gain only if you withdrew it.

items.request: Explain ASP using my savings balance.
items.text: Your 14 600 euros in savings already covers the 10 % share, so the 4 % bonus is secured.

Nordea credits the 1 % interest on 31 December each year.
Once you submit the withdrawal in Nordea's app, the 30 % capital gains tax is applied to the withdrawal.

items.request: Explain ASP using my monthly saving of 400 euros.
items.text: Your 400 euros a month is within the 50 to 1,500 euro limit. After 20 months you would have 8 000 euros deposited.

items.request: Explain PS using my savings balance.
items.text: Your 14 600 euros of ordinary savings is not PS money. Only the money held in the PS account counts toward the 5,000 euro test.

items.request: Explain ASP using my savings balance.
items.text: Your 14 600 euros in savings is yours to use freely. The 10 % share only matters if you apply for an ASP loan.
